user_story: As a cashier, I want to process a lost-ticket case so that a verified driver can pay and exit.
description: Find the unique OPEN session by vehicle number, require a staff verification note, charge the greater of the normal fee and lost-ticket fee, and reuse the normal exit flow.
acceptance_criteria: Only a cashier or parking manager can process a lost ticket.
The amount due is max(normal fee, configured lost-ticket fee).
The original ticket is reused instead of creating another parking session.
The action is written to the audit log.
